title: BigQuery Data Policy Adds SQL Matching Conditions
summary: BigQuery Data Policy now supports defining policies with a `matchingCondition` property, allowing SQL expression strings to dynamically apply policies based on data governance tags. This enables more granular and automated data control.
details: The `DataPolicy` schema has been extended with an optional `matchingCondition` property. This new string field accepts SQL expressions, enabling developers to define precise conditions for when a data policy should apply. It introduces two powerful new functions for tag-based matching: `COLUMN_HAS_TAG_KEY(keyName STRING)` to check for a tag's presence, and `COLUMN_MATCH_TAG(keyName STRING, valueShortName STRING)` to match specific tag values. This significantly enhances the flexibility of data governance by allowing policies to react to the metadata of your BigQuery columns.
